documentationImages.scope: Existing public documentation demo images. The AI-generated concept image is not official DeepSeek artwork.

originalArchiveDigestMeaning: Original private baseline reference, not the redacted public archive. Public compatible archives have their own current digests.
publicTestAdaptations: Deployment tests resolve repository-relative public plugin pins and create isolated fake tool manifests.
Recovery integration requires three explicit absolute fixture arguments and an owned physical sandbox; it never discovers a live updater configuration.
The optional short-path pnpm fixture requires an explicit source checkout before creating temporary data.
The cache ownership fixture resolves its own temporary root to the physical path so Windows 8.3 aliases do not resemble a redirected build cache.
On elevated Windows runners, the ownership fixture assigns the current SID only to its own disposable cache directories before exercising the unchanged ownership guard.
Public runtime helper bytes match the corrected canonical helper; cache ownership and relative deployment fixtures remain public-only adaptations.
runtimeComparisonScope: Original packaged plugin runtime files; documented README redaction and additional licenses are separate.
publicPluginToolAdaptations: The compatibility probe requires an explicit official source checkout and supports both deployed packages and repository baseline-sources.
The declaration checker requires an explicit built official checkout and resolves all 11 public plugin sources and their dependencies without a sibling checkout assumption.
